decisions.decision: Choose Tauri v2 over Electron / Flutter Desktop / MAUI / Avalonia / Wails / Qt
decisions.rationale: Best balance of native feel, bundle size, AI-friendliness, license cleanliness for Win11 + macOS26 cross-platform desktop

decisions.decision: Choose Dev build (not release) for M1.x ship pipeline, accepting 19MB exe size
decisions.rationale: Fast iteration cycle; user originally picked dev but later research showed release build is required for Tauri custom-protocol feature to embed dist

decisions.decision: Switch ship pipeline to release build after M1.1 user feedback about console window
decisions.rationale: Debug build leaves conhost console window orphaned after quit; release build has PE subsystem = GUI which prevents console allocation

decisions.decision: Use cargo build --release --features tauri/custom-protocol instead of tauri build
decisions.rationale: tauri build auto-enables custom-protocol but is slower and bundler-incompatible with our scripts/ pipeline; direct cargo + feature flag gives us same embed behavior with control

decisions.decision: Smoke test must verify structural markers (WebView2 child window class + dist fingerprint in exe), not just process running
decisions.rationale: Original 4-test smoke test passed even with blank/stale/ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED pages — false positive; Test 5/6/7 catch the regression classes

decisions.decision: CLAUDE.md placed in project root (not global) per user choice 2026-06-19
decisions.rationale: User wanted project-specific rules to follow the project, not all projects globally

decisions.decision: M1.4 capabilities config uses WHY annotations in top-level description field, not per-permission
decisions.rationale: JSON doesn't support comments; top-level description is most readable for the WHY notes that span multiple permissions

decisions.decision: macOS impls are compile-only stubs (no runtime tests) on Windows dev box
decisions.rationale: Cross-compile target = apple-darwin not set up; real macOS impls deferred to Mac dev box; macOS stubs satisfy trait contracts for cargo check

decisions.decision: 12 plugin stubs each returning placeholder '该功能将在 M2+ 开发 (plugin: {id})' UI
decisions.rationale: Plugin architecture is verified; business logic deferred to M2+ per project policy
Avoid main session context pollution + ensure subagent quality; matches GSD guidance
